sources.title: How to Run GLM-5.2 Locally (2026 Setup Guide)
sources.snippet: Quick answer. GLM-5.2 is a 744B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model from Z.ai. Unsloth's 2-bit dynamic GGUF compresses it from 1.51 TB down to about 239 GB, so it can plausibly run on a 4x RTX 3090 rig with 192 GB system RAM, a 256 GB+ Mac Studio, or a high-RAM dual-socket workstation. Expect roughly 3 to 9 tokens per second on consumer hardware.
